task.title: Baholar jurnali
task.description: Platforma { name, score } obyektlaridan iborat students massivini beradi. Kiruvchi massivni o‘zgartirmaydigan sof funksiyalar yozing: getAverage(list) - Math.round bilan yaxlitlangan o‘rtacha ball, bo‘sh massiv uchun 0; getExcellentNames(list) - 90 va undan yuqori ball olgan o‘quvchilar ismlari massivi; findStudent(list, name) - o‘quvchi obyekti yoki undefined; addStudent(list, name, score) - { name, score } qo‘shilgan yangi massiv. reduce, filter, map, find va spread ... dan foydalaning.

tests.name: getAverage(students) = 83 (82.5 yaxlitlangan)
tests.fail: Yig‘indi reduce bilan, list.length ga bo‘ling, Math.round bilan yaxlitlang.

tests.name: getAverage boshqa massivda: 70 va 81 → 76
tests.fail: students bo‘yicha emas, list parametri bo‘yicha hisoblang.

tests.name: getAverage([]) = 0
tests.fail: Bo‘sh massivda bo‘lish NaN beradi - oldindan 0 qaytaring: if (list.length === 0) { return 0; }

tests.name: getExcellentNames(students) → ["Anna", "Sardor"]
tests.fail: score >= 90 bo‘yicha filter, keyin map((student) => student.name).

tests.name: Chegara: 90 ball - a’lochi
tests.check: JSON.stringify(getExcellentNames([{ name: "Ira", score: 90 }, { name: "Oleg", score: 89 }])) === JSON.stringify(["Ira"])

tests.name: getExcellentNames([]) → []
tests.fail: filter va map ishlatilsa, bo‘sh massiv uchun bo‘sh massiv qaytadi.

tests.name: O‘quvchi bo‘lmasa, findStudent undefined qaytaradi
tests.fail: find o‘zi undefined qaytaradi - filter massiv qaytarardi.

tests.name: addStudent o‘quvchi qo‘shilgan yangi massiv qaytaradi
tests.check: (() => { const next = addStudent(students, "Ira", 88); return next.length === 5 && next[4].name === "Ira" && next[4].score === 88 && next !== students; })()

tests.name: addStudent asl massivni o‘zgartirmaydi
tests.check: (() => { const before = JSON.stringify(students); addStudent(students, "Ira", 88); return JSON.stringify(students) === before; })()
tests.fail: push asl massivni o‘zgartiradi. Yangisini yarating: [...list, ...].

tests.name: reduce, filter, map, find va ... ishlatilgan
tests.fail: Vazifani qo‘lda yozilgan sikllarsiz, massiv metodlari bilan yeching.

tests.name: Dastur xatosiz bajariladi
tests.fail: Kodda xato bor - uning matnini konsolda o‘qing.

hints: Yig‘indi: list.reduce((sum, student) => sum + student.score, 0) - 0 ni unutmang.
Yangi massiv: [...list, { name, score }] - { name: name, score: score } ning qisqa yozuvi.

questions.question: arr massivining oxirgi elementini qanday olish mumkin? Ifodani kiriting.
Nima chiqadi: const cart = []; cart.push("pishloq"); console.log(cart.length);
questions.explanation: const o‘zgaruvchini qayta tayinlashni taqiqlaydi, massiv ichini o‘zgartirishni emas.

questions.question: Metodni u qaytaradigan narsa bilan moslashtiring.
questions.explanation: Ularning hech biri asl massivni o‘zgartirmaydi.

questions.question: [5, 12, 8, 20].filter((n) => n > 10) nimani qaytaradi?
questions.explanation: filter funksiya true qaytargan elementlarni qoldiradi.

questions.question: [3, 4, 5].reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0) nechaga teng? Sonni kiriting.
user obyektining name xususiyatini o‘qishning qaysi usullari to‘g‘ri?
questions.explanation: Nuqta yoki satrli kvadrat qavslar; JavaScript’da -> yo‘q.

questions.question: [{ id: 1 }, { id: 2 }].find((x) => x.id === 3) nimani qaytaradi?
questions.explanation: Hech narsa topilmasa, find undefined qaytaradi.

questions.question: Qaysi amallar asl massivni o‘zgartiradi?
questions.explanation: map va filter yangi massiv qaytaradi.

questions.question: Nima chiqadi: const user = { name: "Anna", age: 15 }; const { age } = user; console.log(age);
questions.explanation: Destrukturizatsiya user.age qiymatli age konstantasini yaratadi.

questions.question: const a = [1, 2] bo‘lganda yozuvni natija bilan moslashtiring.
